description: No one is responsible for leading the program; champion activities happen ad hoc, if at all.
Someone informally coordinates champion activities alongside other unrelated responsibilities, without a defined mandate.
A captain has been named with a basic mandate, but lacks dedicated time or a clear roadmap.
A dedicated captain leads the program with a documented strategy and roadmap, and is recognized as the program's owner.
The captain role is a well-resourced, recognized position with a clear roadmap, succession planning, and organizational authority to drive the program forward continuously.
